name: global-electricity-mix
title: Global electricity generation mix, annual
description: World total electricity generation and the share generated from solar, wind, all renewables, low-carbon sources (renewables + nuclear) and fossil fuels, 1985–2025. Compiled by Our World in Data from Ember's Yearly Electricity Data and the Energy Institute's Statistical Review of World Energy.

sources.title: Our World in Data — Energy dataset (owid-energy-data.csv)
Ember — Yearly Electricity Data (primary underlying source for recent years)
Energy Institute — Statistical Review of World Energy (underlying source for earlier years)

fields.name: electricity_generation_twh

fields.name: solar_share_elec_pct
